title: Apple reverses planned Hide My Email domain change after user pushback
summary: For reference, Sign in with Apple currently uses privaterelay.appleid.com , while Hide My Email addresses use the same icloud.com domain as regular iCloud email accounts. Today, Apple announced its decision to scrap the planned Hide My Email domain change.
